title: the dry-run card of sonnet-automator carries ROUTE-SCOPE: with the colon and the preset ids
source: intended: PLAN.md defect S1 (route_scope); the TS card prints 'ROUTE-SCOPE' without a colon (cli/jitso/card.ts)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect S1, route_scope). The router reads a scope with the regex (?:^|[.!?])[ \t>*-]*ROUTE-SCOPE:([^\n]*), so the card line must start with ROUTE-SCOPE: (with the colon, at a line start or after . ! ?) and list the preset ids comma separated. On the TS binary today the card writes 'ROUTE-SCOPE <ids>' with no colon, after a '|' separator, so the matcher finds nothing and this case FAILS on TS.
